title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: You better have a driver’s license cause renting a car is the only way to explore Iceland. What’s the point if you can’t stop and stare at the stunning landscape every few minutes?

The distances are long though, and daylight recedes fairly quickly outside of the summer. To optimise for time, we spent our nights in Airbnbs in the tiny towns of Reykholt, Alftaver, and Hella. Reykholt and Hella were far enough inland for aurora sightings.

Do not underestimate driving distances, changing weather or how often you'll pull over for photos. A route that looks efficient on a map can become a very full day once Iceland starts distracting you.
